title: Psychic predicts orbs over the ocean at the Round Table

tellings.quote: this psychic would just blurt out, you know, "11:00, you know, tonight." And they'd go out and they would see an orb.

plain: In the early 1950s, a psychic is said to have predicted when glowing orbs would show up at the Round Table Foundation, a research group on the coast of Maine run by a doctor and psychic researcher named Andrija Puharich. The psychic would call out a time, like "11:00, you know, tonight", and the group would go outside and see an orb. A researcher named Greg Malatzi tells this from Puharich's own journals. If true, it would point to a link between the mind and these lights.
